source_summary: Monochrome ink-and-light-wash winter landscape with tall pale mountains, misty water, snowy rock banks, sparse leafless trees, a small arched bridge with a scholar, a waterside pavilion, and a right-side village compound. Red seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from all motifs.

motifs.name: upper_right_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the tall upper-right mountain cluster: pale rounded peaks with steep vertical sides, dark ink outlines, scattered black texture dots, soft gray interior washes, and mist-softened lower edges. Exclude nearby red seals and blank sky.
must_preserve: irregular dark contour line along the summit and right cliff edge
granular black texture dots on ridges and creases
soft gray wash gradients inside the pale rock forms
misty transition at the lower base of the massif
nested peak shapes and vertical cliff geometry

motifs.name: left_midground_snow_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the left and center-left snowy ridge system with low rolling hills, upright pale spires, and darker dotted ridge contours. Include the small brushy vegetation at the bases where it belongs to the hillside, but omit the bridge and water below.
must_preserve: rounded snow-covered hill silhouettes
vertical pale rock spires in the center-left
dark stippled ink accents along crest lines
soft ink wash shadows on the inner slopes
thin scrubby tree strokes at the foot of the hills

motifs.name: foreground_arching_rock_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the large snow-covered arched rock ridge in the center-right foreground, including its looping opening, pale interior plane, dark dotted crests, and attached snowy boulders. Do not include the village roofs or separate tree grove except tiny shrub marks attached to the rock surface.
must_preserve: arched negative opening inside the ridge
thick pale snow masses with gray wash modeling
black broken contour dots along upper and lower edges
curving ridge geometry that wraps downward to the right
small ink shrub accents clinging to rock edges

motifs.name: winter_stream_and_snow_banks
motifs.description: Isolate the misty stream and pond surfaces across the lower-left and middle ground, with flat gray water washes, snowy islets, irregular banks, and soft reflections. Omit the bridge, scholar, pavilion, and buildings within this area.
must_preserve: broad diluted gray water wash
soft horizontal tonal transitions suggesting mist and reflection
irregular white snowy shoreline shapes
small pale islands and exposed rocks in the water
blurred edges where water meets snow banks

motifs.name: arched_bridge_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the small arched footbridge over the stream with the tiny scholar figure standing or crossing near it. Include the bridge rail/posts and immediate ink strokes needed to read the crossing, but exclude surrounding water and banks except the minimal contact points.
must_preserve: thin curved bridge line
two small vertical bridge supports or rail posts
tiny scholar figure with dark head and fine robe strokes
delicate walking-stick or staff-like line near the figure
minimal contact shadows where bridge meets the banks

motifs.name: lakeside_open_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the small open pavilion on the snowy island in the lower center-left: hipped roof, four posts, railings, platform, and the immediate snowy mound supporting it. Do not include the larger water field or nearby unrelated trees.
must_preserve: low hipped roof with soft snow-like wash
straight post-and-beam geometry
small railing and platform linework
dark accent dots along the roof edge and island edge
pale snowy island base beneath the structure

motifs.name: right_village_compound
motifs.description: Isolate the compact village or house compound at the lower right: layered sloping roofs, open pavilion-like side structure, fence or wall lines, and the small human figure under the eaves. Include only the immediate snowy ground tied to the buildings.
must_preserve: stacked roof geometry with dark eave lines
fine wall, fence, and doorway strokes
small seated or standing figure beneath the front eaves
light gray roof washes and snow accents
compact arrangement of buildings tucked into the rocks

motifs.name: foreground_leafless_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the cluster of bare winter trees rising through the foreground rocks from center to right, including multiple dark trunks, branching twig networks, and sparse brushy undergrowth. Exclude nearby pavilion and village architecture.
must_preserve: dark tapering trunks with dry-brush texture
angular leafless branch networks
fine twig ends and broken ink strokes
root-like bases emerging from snow-covered rocks
subtle gray wash around trunks and undergrowth

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
